[EVENT] User is looking for fashion advice for a night out with friends this weekend.  
[FACT] User has new ankle boots from H&M.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested trendy outfit combos to pair with the ankle boots:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Combo 1: Chic & Casual - Pair ankle boots with a flowy mini dress in neutral shades or a white/light-colored blouse with high-waisted black jeans and a statement belt.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Combo 2: Edgy Chic - Team boots with high-waisted distressed denim jeans and a fitted black turtleneck sweater, or a graphic t-shirt with a fitted blazer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Combo 3: Feminine Flair - Pair boots with a flowy midi-length skirt in a bold print or bright color, or a fitted knee-length dress with tights.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Combo 4: Monochromatic - Pair boots with matching or similar-colored pants or a skirt, and a crisp white or light-colored top.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] General tips: Balance outfit volume, experiment with textures, and add a pop of color with accessories.  
[PREFERENCE] User likes the sound of Combo 1.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested pairing the mini dress with a cardigan instead of a denim jacket, providing tips on color contrast and texture.
